messages.content: Tell me about the Great Pumpkin Riot at Syracuse University in 1987.

response.text:
Based on all available historical records, university archives, and news reports, **there was no "Great Pumpkin Riot" at Syracuse University in 1987.**

It is likely that this is either a "mandela effect" memory, a local campus legend, or a piece of misinformation. 

Syracuse University has a long history of student activism and occasional campus unrest, but there is no documented event involving a riot centered around pumpkins in 1987. If this is a story you heard from a specific source or a particular alumni group, it may be an inside joke or a highly localized prank that never reached the level of a "riot" or official record.

If you are thinking of a different event—perhaps a specific protest, a different year, or a different university—feel free to provide more details and I can help you track it down!
